The Mindful Desk
Posted by: Rowan Petrie | Date: October 6

Rethinking What We Write On

The waste created by disposable stationery is becoming impossible to overlook. That’s why I want to inform you of some information about a young business called Foliage Paper Co. It is transforming the market by producing notebooks using only recycled paper and mineral-based inks. Unlike cheap notebooks that fall apart within weeks, this company’s covers and bindings are remarkably strong.

And now is the ideal moment to sample this company’s range, as it is giving out a complimentary bookmark set to anyone who visits one of its market booths in town squares around the region this weekend. If you miss out, you can still visit www.foliagepaper.com to order well-made stationery at a reasonable price.
